name: ai-inline-edit

frames.best_why: The review bar shows Accept and Discard while the changed words are marked in the sentence.

tagline: Select a sentence, ask for an edit, and review the rewrite inline.
summary: An editable document where selecting text opens a small Ask AI bar under the sentence. A rewritten version streams in word by word as a green and red diff you can accept, retry or discard.
appearance: A rounded dark card titled "Billing launch update" with three muted paragraphs, and a floating pale bar below the selected sentence. The bar holds an input and four action chips, or Accept and Discard with a version counter.
behaviour: Selecting a sentence opens the prompt bar; choosing or typing an instruction starts a word-by-word rewrite with a caret. The finished diff shows green additions and struck-through removals until Accept applies it or Discard reverts.
demo_content: A billing launch update with three paragraphs about the new dashboard and invoices.
search_phrases: select text ask ai to rewrite
word level diff in a document
use_when: A writing surface should let people rewrite a sentence in place and compare the change before accepting.
avoid_when: It edits one paragraph at a time, needs a selection first, and the demo rewrite is a local rule set.
customise: Title, paragraphs, a rewrite function that can return text or a stream, and an onChange callback are props; the demo's canned rewrites live in the file.
weight_why: Timers and small text animations run only while a rewrite is in flight.

a11y.note: Buttons carry labels and keep focus while phases swap, but selecting text is the only way to start an edit.

issues: The prompt bar covers the paragraph while open, hiding the lines just below the selection.
polish_why: Convincing in-place editing with a neat diff; the prompt bar overlaps the text it is editing.
title: AI Inline Edit
